articles.summary: SUFFOLK, Va., July 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - TowneBank (the "Company" or "Towne") (NASDAQ: TOWN) today reported earnings for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 of $193.19 million, or $2.09 per diluted share, compared to $40.89 million, or $0.54 per diluted share, for the quarter ended June 30, 2025. Excluding certain items affecting comparability, core earnings (non-GAAP) were $72.01 million, or $0.78 per diluted share, in the current quarter compared to $63.39 million, or $0.84 per diluted share
articles.title: TowneBank Reports Second Quarter 2026 Earnings
